profile.description: 这是一种电动精密Y轴线性位移台，属于 Zaber Luminos 多轴位移平台系统的一部分。它用于在实验中对样品、探针或光学元件进行精细直线定位与对准，适合需要微步进、速度与加速度控制的精密运动场景。
profile.description_en: This is a motorized precision Y-axis linear stage that forms part of the Zaber Luminos multi-axis positioning system. It is used in laboratories for fine linear positioning and alignment of samples, probes, or optical components in experiments that require precise stepping, speed control, and acceleration control.
